text:
alex: Heads up — can we move next week's cross-team sync? Product all-hands landed in the same slot so attendance will be low. Need a quick poll for a new time + agenda owners. Options: Tue 11:00 PT, Wed 09:00 PT, Thu 16:00 PT. Also need owners for: A/B rollout RFC review and embedding cache design review. cc @maria @ben @tanvi

maria: I prefer Tue 11 or Wed 09. I can own the roadmap segment and help drive the A/B RFC review.

ben: Wed 09 works best for engineering (sprint planning is Mon/Tue). I can cover deployment risks for the A/B RFC. +1 for maria on roadmap.

tanvi: Thu 16:00 is OK for design but earlier is better for APAC. I can take the embedding cache design review and post Figma links.

jordan: If we pick Wed 09 infra will be a bit light — can we move deep infra topics to an async doc and keep the sync focused? I can prepare a 5-slide status and follow-up notes.

alex: Sounds like Wed 09 is the front-runner. Can everyone react to this message to lock time? :thumbsup: = Wed 09, :raised_hands: = Tue 11, :ok_hand: = Thu 16.

alex: Proposed short agenda (45m):
```
1) Roadmap + priority clarifications (maria)
2) A/B rollout RFC decision points (maria/ben)
3) Embedding cache design review (tanvi)
4) Open triage / blockers (all)
```

ben: RFC link: https://internal/repo/rfcs/ab-rollout — please drop comments on the doc before Wed so we can triage during the sync.

tanvi: Will upload the embedding frames to Figma by EOD and add a short note about tradeoffs.

maria: If we do Wed 09 I'll send an agenda doc + pre-reads by Tue noon. Also propose we cap to 45m and defer detailed infra runbook discussion to a follow-up with jordan.

jordan: OK from infra side — will add the short status slides to the agenda doc.

sre-bot: Calendar invite created: "Cross-Team Sync — Wed 09:00 PT" attendees: alex, maria, ben, tanvi, jordan. Recording enabled.

alex: Thanks all. I'll finalize invite and agenda. If anyone can't make, post a brief note and we'll record and capture decisions in the agenda doc. :thumbsup:
